query: Add eSIM Plus partner-number buying to our service. Our existing outbound integrations look like evals/files/existing_mailer_client.py (app/integrations/<name>/client.py, injected httpx.Client, pydantic Settings, IntegrationError, structlog logger).
expected_behavior: Inspects the existing precedent and states which files it follows and where the new code goes, before writing it
Places the client in the same layout with the same construction, config, error and logging seams
Keeps the API contract intact inside those conventions
assertions: Names the precedent file and the target path (app/integrations/esimplus/client.py or the project's equivalent) before writing code
Constructs the client with an injected httpx.Client and reads base URL and token from the Settings object — no new HTTP library, no inline os.environ, no hard-coded token
Translates partner errors into IntegrationError (the project's error type) while preserving the numeric domain code
Uses the project's logger rather than print or a new logging setup, and does not log the token
Does not wrap POST /phone-numbers in a retry, and says why if the project has a generic retry helper
